summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K on 2026-11-05 furnishing Exhibit 99.1, its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under Chapter 19B covering movements in securities for the month ended 31 October 2026. The return reports no change in issued shares: 829,269,523 Class A and 110,996,801 Class B ordinary shares, for 940,266,324 total, with authorized capital unchanged at USD 200,000 and a 25% public float threshold confirmed as met. No stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is stated. What to watch: routine Hong Kong monthly disclosure, not a special situation.
